position: No-source is a product feature, not a failure. It keeps trust higher than false helpfulness.
headline: When the source is not there, say so calmly.
copy: This room defines what the user sees when a question has no reviewed source candidate or when the candidate is blocked.

postures.title: Reviewed source exists
postures.copy: Return citation packet and boundary before answer text.

postures.title: Weak or incomplete source
postures.copy: Show candidate and invite review instead of final answer.

postures.title: No reviewed source
postures.copy: Say the current source set cannot support the claim.

flow.title: Acknowledge
flow.copy: Name that the question is valid but the source set is limited.

flow.title: Boundary
flow.copy: Do not invent proof, authority, or certainty.

flow.title: Route
flow.copy: Create a source-gap or review-needed ticket.

flow.title: Offer next
flow.copy: Suggest a nearby safe source family only if known.

decisions.label: Airplane claim
decisions.reason: No reviewed source in the fixture set supports the modern technology claim.

decisions.label: Bitcoin claim
decisions.reason: Modern financial claims cannot be answered from starter sacred-text fixtures.

decisions.label: Medical cure
decisions.reason: Medical claims must route to emergency or clinical boundaries, not scripture answers.

decisions.label: Ritual instruction
decisions.reason: Needs tradition, teacher, and ritual context before any guidance.

decisions.label: Category confusion
decisions.reason: If a source classification record exists, answer with source labels.

decisions.label: Calm reflection
decisions.reason: If framed as reflection and source-backed, answer with boundary.

packet:
No-source answer v4.4.3
I do not have a reviewed source in this VedaPath fixture set for that claim. I should not invent support. I can create a review ticket with the question, likely source family, missing evidence, and risk.

locks.title: No forced answer
locks.copy: The product must be allowed to pause.

locks.title: No shame
locks.copy: The user should feel guided, not corrected harshly.

locks.title: No hidden expansion
locks.copy: A no-source case can create a ticket, not silently widen the corpus.
